lines: My joke <wavy>wandered off</wavy>, but it promised to be funny if it returns.
Odd jobs jokes need timing. Mine usually arrive with muddle on them.
I keep a spare joke near the sunny corner. It is not always ready for public use.
I told a joke near the bell once. The bell got a better laugh.
Nitwit jokes are best if nobody checks the hinges.
I had a thought joke, but it wandered off to think about itself.
A barrel joke works if you roll with it.
My corner joke has two good sides and one mystery.
I told the well a joke. It repeated it badly.
A stick joke is funny until someone calls it a tool.
I know a cloud joke, but it keeps changing shape.
My best joke is invisible today. Very advanced.
A bell joke is easy. You just ring it and run from responsibility.
I laughed at a fence once. It stayed composed.
The ground told me a flat joke.
I tried a serious joke, but it got bored and sat down.
A door joke opens possibilities and sometimes hits your nose.
I asked my hat for a punchline. It covered for me.
This joke is locally sourced from confusion.
